name: Chapter 2 Starter Guide
description: This series provides 10 playtested decks using the Chapter 2 Core and new Starters, with each deck compatible for two player with at least 7 others (and working well at high player counts).

decks.introMd: Marie gets Cash4Blood using [Offering Bowl](/card/60456) and [Jim Culver](/card/60479), which also activates her excellent ability. She also hoovers up clues like a Seeker, while giving enemies the slip with [Shadowmeld](/card/60461) - definitely more the Witch and less the Performer!

Here big money André makes it rain with [Marcus](/card/60375), [Sticky Fingers](/card/12048), [Thieves' Kit](/card/12049), [Emergency Cache](/card/01088), ["Watch this!"](/card/60371) and [Out the Door](/card/60370). He then puts this cash to work, with [Well Connected](/card/60381) for boosts and [Black Fan](/card/60379) for a raft of benefits. Don't believe what they say - money <ins>does</ins> buy happiness!

Here, Tommy uses [Winchester Model 12](/card/12029) with plenty of bullets from [Stock Ammo Reload](/card/60175) to blast away enemies, dealing up to 17 damage with two [Vicious Blows](/card/12025). Did you expect anything else?!

Here Carolyn uses books to get clues while taking horror ([Dreamer's Chronicle](/card/60255), [Scroll of the Pharaohs](/card/60281)), and then she uses other books to heal horror and get a clue from her ability ([Experimental Psychology](/card/60252), [Occult Records](/card/60256)). *Then*, she uses another book ([Mysterious Grimoire](/card/12040)) to draw cards. Makes [Daisy](/card/01502) look like a rank, ill-educated freshman!

Using his trusty [Knapsack](/card/60552), Miguel lays fast traps like [Lie in Wait](/card/60566) or [Glassing](/card/60563) one location away and then drags enemies into them with [Loner](/card/60557). For any foes that survive the trip, this rancher Rambo uses [Longbow](/card/60580) to finish them off.

If Mystics are about power at a price, then Faustian bargains don't come much more Faustian than [Dread Curse of Azathoth](/card/60474)! Here Dexter uses that and upgraded [Cosmic Flame](/card/12071) for some serious diabolic firepower - made all the more accessible with [Arcane Initiate](/card/60455) and ["For my next trick..."](/card/12011).

Rather than cowering from the [Black Chamber Operative](/card/12009), Trish uses pocket sand (or [Caustic Reaction](/card/60261) if you want to get technical) and [pushing him off a roof](/card/60378) to excellent effect! She even hunts the Operative out of her deck with [Mysterious Grimoire](/card/12040) - a bold move if I ever saw one...

Here Daniela uses [Stalk Prey](/card/60567) to spawn enemies, [Lesson Learned](/card/12022) and [Detective Sherman](/card/60177) to exploit those enemies for clues, and then [Hunter's Instinct](/card/12074) to recycle events. Oh, and she also still [Sledgehammers](/card/12028) bad guys into meaty paste (yes I did use "sledgehammer" as a verb...).
Here avenging Izzie heals both damage and horror through skill tests on Mystic assets, which allows her to readily soak attacks and so dish out [Retribution](/card/60473). #Justice4Jenny

Here, Joe has had enough of your crap! Rather than quietly investigating, he's whipping out his [M1911](/card/60171) and going pow-pow-pow! He may do some sleuthing on the side, with [Sharp Rhetoric](/card/60277) or whatever, but really this PI is all about the DIY - and by DIY I mean DIY vigilantism...
